subject: Business Studies
central_question: How do managers guide, motivate, lead and communicate with employees so that organisational plans are converted into coordinated action?

known_pitfalls.correction: It includes instructing, guiding, counselling, motivating, leading and communicating.

known_pitfalls.claim: All employees respond to money in the same way.
known_pitfalls.correction: People differ and require suitable financial and non-financial incentives.

known_pitfalls.claim: Communication ends when a message is sent.
known_pitfalls.correction: It requires understanding by the receiver and feedback.

ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Exercises contain Very Short Answer questions 1-4, Short Answer questions 1-6 and Long Answer questions 1-4.
